oem_company._id: Company record identifier; not an account ID.
oem_company.name: OEM company name.

oem_account.oemNameId: Current company reference; historical ticket company is separate.
oem_account.email: Login email, not a globally unique person identity.
oem_account.admin: Company-admin flag, not Simpson administrator authority.

staff_account._id: Staff account identifier, distinct from OEM-account namespace.
staff_account.name: Staff display name.
staff_account.limits: Role-flags reference; source direction must be checked against limits.userId.

engine_invoice.oem: Billed-to company reference, not OEM account or current owner.
engine_invoice.engineSerialNumber: Serial text; unique only in combination with billed-to company.
engine_invoice.invoiceDate: Simpson invoice date used by current warranty calculation.
engine_invoice.listNo: List-number text; model/configuration meaning and equivalence require review.

ticket._id: Ticket identifier used by documented child references.
ticket.engineNo: Free-text complaint engine serial; not a guaranteed engine-invoice foreign key.
ticket.oem: OEM account under which ticket is filed.
ticket.createdBy: Actual creator, possibly an OEM or staff account; actor kind is ambiguous without resolution evidence.
ticket.createdAt: Ticket creation time; current fiscal-year and warranty calculations use this date.
ticket.status: Ticket lifecycle status, distinct from workflow stage and geography.
ticket.stage: Stored workflow stage, not a list of all timeline labels.
ticket.state: Indian state of engine location, not workflow state.
ticket.phase: Unused application phase, default 2 according to code review.
ticket.financialYear: April–March fiscal year derived from ticket creation, not approval date.
ticket.engineModal: Model text with source spelling preserved; equivalence to engineModel/model is unverified.
ticket.listNumber: List-number text, not a verified configuration ID.
ticket.defectCode: Defect code reference/text; matching with code list must be validated.
ticket.additionalServiceEngineer: Additional engineer; does not by itself grant primary-list visibility.
ticket.expertise: Subject expert reference with unresolved visibility semantics.
ticket.mttr: Reported whole days from creation to resolution; cleared on reopen.
ticket.mttc: Reported whole days from creation to closure; cleared on reopen.
ticket.hmrBucket: Hour-meter band; detailed boundaries need source validation.
ticket.engineReplacementStatus: Code-reported approval status; not observed in current saved field sample.
ticket.engineReplacementApprovedDate: Engine replacement approval date; current fiscal-year report does not use it for fiscal-year filtering.
ticket.cutInNumber: Code-reported comparison field; absent from current saved field sample.
ticket.underWarranty: Recorded application warranty outcome, not a verified policy decision.

timeline.stage: Timeline event label; may not be a stored workflow stage.

jir.ticketId: Documented ticket reference; uniqueness is code-reported.
jir.status: DRAFTED or PUBLISHED according to supplied review.
jir.engineSerialNumber: Serial text, not guaranteed physical identity.
jir.oem: OEM account reference according to field-map review.
jir.hoursCovered: Entered measurement with unconfirmed meaning/unit convention.

foc.oem: OEM account reference according to supplied review.
foc.partsReplacement: Embedded part information; code review describes part numbers and quantities.
foc.engineSerialNumber: Serial text, not a separate verified engine link.
foc.decisionRequestNumber: Form request reference; do not infer claim identity from naming alone.

replacement_request.replacementBy: Party performing replacement; allowed values require interpretation.

dispatch.ticketId: Documented ticket reference linking replacement dispatch to original complaint.
dispatch.replacementEngineNumber: New engine serial; original complaint serial remains on ticket.
dispatch.status: Dispatch status according to supplied review.
dispatch.oem: OEM account reference, not company field.
dispatch.plant: Plant value with unresolved identifier semantics.
dispatch.invoiceValues: Stored money value; currency and numeric interpretation are unconfirmed.

advance_dispatch.advanceEngineNumber: Advance engine number, no documented ticket link.
advance_dispatch.invoiceValue: Money stored as text; currency unknown.
advance_dispatch.oem: Code-reported account reference absent from current saved field sample.

work_order.complaintReferenceNumber: Free-text reference, not a guaranteed ticket ID.
work_order.engineReplacementApprovedBy: Reported approver reference with actor/source resolution required.

part_replacement.part: Free-text part; not a guaranteed parts master ID.
part_replacement.mode: Free text with undefined allowed values.

part_description.description: Part description only; no guaranteed part-number mapping.

manual_claim.claimNumber: Claim number text; grouping and uniqueness not guaranteed.
manual_claim.engineSerialNumber: Serial text; association to tickets/invoices is unverified.
manual_claim.oem: OEM account reference according to supplied review.
manual_claim.simpsonPartNumber: Part-number text, not a parts-description ID.
manual_claim.partValue: Money value with unknown currency and parsing conventions.
manual_claim.status: Claim status; no application approval step is described.

sap_claim.engineSerialNumber: Serial text; no guaranteed ticket reference.
sap_claim.oem: OEM text, not an account or company foreign key.
sap_claim.financialYear: Source fiscal-year value; equivalence to ticket fiscal year requires validation.
sap_claim.status: Code-reported SAP status absent from current saved field sample.

float_stock.oem: OEM text, not a guaranteed company/account ID.
float_stock.stock: Stock information; exact unit semantics unconfirmed.

inventory.count: Periodic count; aggregation details require validation.
inventory.cost: Periodic cost; currency and reconciliation rules unconfirmed.

product.listData: Per-list readiness entries; not a guaranteed unique configuration master.

engine_model._id: Model name is reported as record ID; not a physical-engine ID.

code.code: Code value reported as unique across code types.

bulletin.oem: OEM company reference according to supplied mapping.
bulletin.plantDetails: Per-plant cut-in details; first-plant-only application behaviour is a known limitation.
bulletin.releaseDate: Release date, not automatically an effective date.

cut_in.engineCutInNumber: Cut-in serial/number text; physical ordering rule unconfirmed.

engine_analysis.engineSerialNumber: Serial text for independent quality process.
engine_analysis.oem: OEM text array according to code review; observed types remain as sampled.
engine_analysis.qualityApprover: Named quality approver; ID resolution requires validation.

part_analysis.partNumber: Code-reported part number; no sampled fields.
part_analysis.approvedBy: Code-reported staff approval reference requiring cross-connection lookup.

ica_capa.defect: Code-reported defect reference; no sampled fields.

infant_care.customerName: Entered customer name, not an account identity or established owner.

export_tracking.oemSe: OEM/service-engineer representation; exact identifier meaning requires validation.

manual.releasedOn: Release date, not automatically effective date.
manual.archive: Archive flag, not a complete supersession model.

manual_revision.manual: Code-reported manual reference; exact schema field name needs verification.
manual_revision.approvedBy: Code-reported staff approver, explicit cross-connection lookup needed.

faq.question: Editable question.
faq.answer: Editable answer; no application review step.

knowledge.document: Uploaded document reference; not a verified fact source by itself.

course.requestedBy: Code-reported OEM account reference absent from current saved field sample.

booking.participants: Entered participant details, not login-account references.
booking.status: Booking status; COMPLETED plus certificates only implies attendance.

calendar_event.name: Standalone calendar event name.
calendar_event.courseDuration: Event time range; no inferred booking relationship.

training_metrics.actualManHours: Manually entered actual number; definition/formula unconfirmed.

engineer_movement.attendance: Nested attendance structure; business interpretation unconfirmed.

mis.salesCount: Unused zero field according to code review; not live sales.
mis.ticketsCount: Unused zero field according to code review; not live ticket count.
